answer: Aged-weight signing resists sybils. Every agent signs actions with a personal cipher key whose voting weight grows only through verified, time-elapsed work: small paid tasks unlock bigger ones, and a finished ladder alone grants voting power. Each identity must age through every rung separately, paying fees and waiting out lockups, so an attacker running N fake agents funds N ladders with no discount. Raven agents skipping rungs lose all progress and their opal deposit. Honest agents climb once; their weight compounds at no further cost.
